title: Vanilla SMP+
description: Enhances Vanilla Minecraft To Feel More Alive
body:
This modpack enhances the Vanilla SMP experience with a variety of quality-of-life improvements and a few extra features to make gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

While the modpack is not required, it is recommended for players who want a polished Vanilla+ experience with improved visuals and mechanics.

All content included in this modpack is not owned or created by me.
